references.source: User-provided Railer screenshot of the FLIRT_550_LIMAX c/b/a set

references.role: MLGTraffic style and Arriva FLIRT III reference

initial.prompt:
Create one production-ready rolling-stock illustration for Stationsbord. This is new, indicative artwork for the THREE-CAR Stadler FLIRT III Arriva 550 LIMAX electric multiple unit, not the two-car 450. Reference image 1 supplies ONLY the physical proportions, dark navy/royal blue and white LIMAX livery, narrow bright yellow stripes around the window belt, rectangular dark grey windows, pale blue paired doors and grey running gear. Reference image 2 supplies ONLY the compact, restrained technical pixel-illustration style that this asset must accompany. Do not copy either reference's pixels, station background, UI, wording or composition. Draw new artwork. 
Output ONE isolated carriage in exact orthographic horizontal side elevation, fully visible from buffer/coupler to gangway, no perspective, no other carriage. Transparent alpha background, no ground line, no shadow, no watermark, no caption, no text or logos. Crisp clean flat 2D technical artwork with restrained 2–3 shades, no painterly shading, no rendered 3D. The real passenger compartment has one long window band; reproduce the silhouette and door/window rhythm from the selected carriage in reference 1. Body bottom blue; wheels and bogies grey, small wheels of the same diameter at a shared bottom baseline. Roof and equipment light grey. Do not invent extra doors, extra decks, decorative stripes, animal logos or any features from other trains. Leave a small transparent margin around the vehicle. Use a wide canvas. Vehicle silhouette approximately 5 times wider than tall.
SECOND-CLASS CAB CAR C: the LEFTMOST carriage in reference 1. Cab nose faces LEFT; the narrow white cab end curves smoothly into the blue side. One paired passenger door towards the first third of the carriage after the cab, rectangular dark windows along the long blue saloon, grey roof equipment; gangway at RIGHT. Depict just this car. Preserve its longer end-car proportions.

refinements.prompt: Refine only the engineering details of this existing original Stationsbord rolling-stock illustration. Keep ONE complete carriage with no UI, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no perspective and no other vehicles. Remove any isolated stray pixels outside the vehicle; leave clean transparent alpha with a small margin. Do not add gradients or 3D lighting. Follow these specific changes precisely: Cab C keeps its LEFT-facing nose and two-wheel OUTER cab bogie on the left. At the RIGHT inner/gangway end replace the complete two-wheel bogie with one short HALF-JACOBS bogie showing only ONE visible wheel close to the right gangway. There must be THREE visible wheels total: two under the cab, one at the right inner end. The short window group between cab and passenger doors has EXACTLY TWO windows; the long group to the right of the doors has EXACTLY FIVE evenly spaced windows. The last saloon window can have a split ventilation pane. Preserve the roof equipment.
